study_identification_part.si_4_title: Microstructural mapping of neural pathways in Alzheimer's disease using macrostructure-informed normative tractometry

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study proposes 'Macrostructure-Informed Normative Tractometry (MINT)' which uses a Variational Autoencoder with 1D convolutional layers (ConVAE) to jointly model microstructural measures and bundle geometry.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We propose a novel macrostructure-informed normative tractometry (MINT) framework to investigate how white matter (WM) microstructure and macrostructure are jointly altered in mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and dementia. ... MINT... jointly model microstructural measures and cooccurring variations in bundle geometry with a variational autoencoder (VAE). ... In MINT, we use 1D convolutional layers to model streamline-level information.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Feng2025.pdf.md: Abstract / Methods; Section 2.3.1 Macrostructure modeling

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The model uses four DTI metrics (FA, MD, RD, AxD) and streamline coordinates (macrostructure/shape). The shape component is referred to as 'MAE-Shape' in the results, representing geometrical distortion.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: MINT is trained on whole-brain macrostructure as well as the four standard DTI microstructural measures. ... with seven input features x, y, z, FA, MD, RD, and AxD. ... For each subject's bundle, X , we created along-tract profiles for a total of nine features: MAE scores were calculated for five features... MAE-Shape, MAE-FA, MAE-MD, MAE-RD, and MAE-AxD
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Feng2025.pdf.md: Section 2.3.1 Macrostructure modeling; Section 2.3.3 Bundle profiling

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The normative model (VAE) is unconditional and does not use explanatory variables like age or sex as inputs. It learns the distribution of healthy controls' data (streamline coordinates and DTI metrics). Age and Sex are used later in the linear regression analysis of the deviation scores (MAE), but not in the normative model itself.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: MINT can learn the patterns of statistical variation in whole-brain macrostructure by training it on streamlines (3D curves) from multiple bundles. ... Each streamline was resampled to 128 equidistant points... with seven input features x, y, z, FA, MD, RD, and AxD. ... A linear regression model was fitted... MAE ~ Age + Sex + DX
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Feng2025.pdf.md: Section 2.3.1 Macrostructure modeling; Section 2.3.2 Data preparation and training; Section 2.4 Statistical analysis of diagnostic group differences
